baseline_harness: Baseline commit plus identical candidate Cargo.toml, progress.rs and io_uring_direct.rs benchmark files; no runtime changes.

zram0                                  8G    0
nvme0n1 SAMSUNG MZVL21T0HCLR-00BL7 953.9G    0
profile: cargo bench (optimized, default workspace release settings), single worker, 64 KiB block, 4096 alignment, one buffer; same storage device for source and destination
workload: 16 MiB dense and 50% sparse with alternating 64 KiB extents, deterministic incompressible Data. Warm buffered source. Reset destination with incompressible bytes and flush before every timed execution.
timing: Plan benchmark measures plan_with_destination. Copy benchmark measures execute_plan or execute_plan_with_observer including structural validation and destination flush, excluding initial planning, reset, and read-back verification. Entire output verified after each timed copy.
sampling: Initial comparison: 20 samples, flat, 300 ms warmup, 1 s measurement target; 3 runs per source version on Btrfs, order baseline/candidate, candidate/baseline, baseline/candidate.
limits: Development laptop, frequency scaling and background activity not controlled; no CPU affinity. API/observer comparison, not sustained device bandwidth qualification. CPU/RSS/latency counters not instrumented.
build_isolation: Separate target/r01-baseline-build and target/r01-candidate-build; executable hashes differ. Shared-output-directory attempt discarded.
followup: Fragmented copy matrix repeated with 40 samples, 500 ms warmup, 3 s measurement target; 3 runs per source version, order candidate/baseline, baseline/candidate, candidate/baseline. Triggered by initial counter median increase above 5%.
discarded_attempts: tmpfs sparse source allocation map became dense before copy, even after replacing whole-source read with Data-only reads; cause not established. Both attempts failed rather than reporting successful performance. Attempt 1 also used a shared Cargo output directory and is invalid for comparison. Accepted runs use Btrfs and isolated builds.
